say:1:1010409001:0.text: Lady Vala! It's been quite difficult to get a meeting with you, my lady.
say:1:1010409001:0.source_cn: 维拉夫人！啊……见你一面简直比登天还难。

say:3:1010409002:0.text: You've got some nerve, Lord Franz. Is this how you respond when someone has no time to meet with you? By picking quarrels at their doorstep?
say:3:1010409002:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨先生，您可真是好大的面子。我有事无暇见您，您便要...

say:4:1010409003:0.text: You misunderstand, my lady... These miscreants were the ones who started the fight, not I!
say:4:1010409003:0.source_cn: 冤枉啊夫人……不怪我惹是生非，是这些人胡搅蛮缠！

say:8:1010409004:0.text: My noble lady, your eyes are as clear and brilliant as the stars in the night sky. Surely, you can see through the lies this man is telling you!
say:8:1010409004:0.source_cn: 尊贵的夫人，您那双眼睛亮如晚星，我相信它们一定能穿透谎...

say:9:1010409005:0.text: I care little for your petty squabbles.
say:9:1010409005:0.source_cn: 你们的黑与白，是与非，我不关心。

say:10:1010409006:0.text: If you wish to continue this farce, I demand that you do it elsewhere. If even one of my flowers gets stepped on, you will all suffer my wrath.
say:10:1010409006:0.source_cn: 只是要动粗请去别处，不要践踏了我的花园。

say:13:1010409007:0.text: Please don't be upset, my lady. It breaks my heart to see a frown on a face as beautiful and flawless as yours.
say:13:1010409007:0.source_cn: 别这么严肃。夫人，您适合多笑一笑，总是绷着脸，着实浪费...

say:14:1010409008:0.text: I beg your pardon, sir. While you do not wear the armor of the Heroic Order... Am I right to presume that you are a member of the Solitaries?
say:14:1010409008:0.source_cn: 这位先生，虽然你没穿骑士团的铠甲，但是我想……你是“隐...

say:15:1010409009:0.text: Why is someone like you getting involved in petty disputes such as this?
say:15:1010409009:0.source_cn: 此间种种，不过乡土凡事之争，真的需要身为“隐士”的你插...

say:16:1010409010:0.text:
?!
What do you mean, my lady?

say:17:1010409011:0.text: Spying, secrets, gossip-mongering... The Solitaries are known to be masters of deception. The Heroic Order are the swords and shields of the nobility. How can one be unaware of those who serve them?
say:17:1010409011:0.source_cn: 谍信、秘闻、情报，流言……这些不是“隐士”的专属。骑士...

say:18:1010409012:0.text: ... Then it is I who have taken the liberty.

say:19:1010409013:0.text: There, now you sound much more like a Solitary.
say:19:1010409013:0.source_cn: 说得好，骑士先生，这才是“隐士”之风。

say:23:1010409014:0.text: Hey, Magister... Even though that lady was talking to Valen, why does it feel like she's been staring at you all this time?
say:23:1010409014:0.source_cn: 主、主人……我怎么觉得，那位夫人明明是在跟维伦说话，眼...
say:23:1010409014:0.male: Hey, Magister... Even though that lady was talking to Valen, why does it feel like she's been staring at you all this time?
say:23:1010409014:0.female: Hey, Magister... Even though that lady was talking to Valen, why does it feel like she's been staring at you all this time?

say:26:1010409017:0.text: Ah, she finally looked away... Her stare is so sharp! Like a dagger! Chippy's heart almost jumped out of his chest...
say:26:1010409017:0.source_cn: 啊！她把视线挪开了……她的视线像箭尖般犀利……我的心脏...
say:26:1010409017:0.male: Ah, she finally looked away... Her stare is so sharp! Like a dagger! Chippy's heart almost jumped out of his chest...
say:26:1010409017:0.female: Ah, she finally looked away... Her stare is so sharp! Like a dagger! Chippy's heart almost jumped out of his chest...

say:29:1010409018:0.text: Now then, Lord Franz. What could be so urgent that you would disturb me like this?
say:29:1010409018:0.source_cn: 那么，弗朗茨先生，你这次找我有何贵干？

say:32:1010409019:0.text: My lady, I merely wish to extend an invitation to the <style="highlight">Golden Banquet</style>.

say:33:1010409020:0.text: This year's harvest of the Gemvine was quite good. I will host a banquet in celebration. I would like to invite you to come.
say:33:1010409020:0.source_cn: 今年藤水晶大丰收，我想在庄园里举办宴会庆祝。您正好在圣...

say:35:1010409022:0.text:
Now, if that is all, I'd like to go get some rest.
I wish you all a pleasant day and safe travels.
say:35:1010409022:0.source_cn: 要是没有别的事，我先回去休息了。\n请各位慢走，不送。

narration:37:1010409023:0.text: Before she leaves, Lady Vala peers toward us with a mysterious look on her face.
narration:37:1010409023:0.source_cn: 临走前，维拉夫人向这边深深地望了一眼，意味不明

say:40:1010409025:0.text:
Why do you ask? Does the idea frighten you?
There are only two kinds of people who receive this kind of special treatment from the Heroic Order.
say:40:1010409025:0.source_cn: 怎么，你怕了？别怕啊。\n能被骑士团天天跟着，只有两种...

say:41:1010409026:0.text:
The first are important figures like <style="stress"><player_name></style> over here.
The second... are greedy, no-good criminals like you.
say:41:1010409026:0.male:
The first are important figures like <style="stress"><player_name></style> over here.
The second... are greedy, no-good criminals like you.
say:41:1010409026:0.female:
The first are important figures like <style="stress"><player_name></style> over here.
The second... are greedy, no-good criminals like you.

say:42:1010409027:0.text: Ha! You claim this <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a person of import?
say:42:1010409027:0.male: Ha! You claim this <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a person of import?
say:42:1010409027:0.female: Ha! You claim this <style="stress"><player_name></style> is a person of import?

say:43:1010409028:0.text: With neither wealth nor title, what makes him any different from the rest of the common rabble?
say:43:1010409028:0.male: With neither wealth nor title, what makes him any different from the rest of the common rabble?
say:43:1010409028:0.female: With neither wealth nor title, what makes her any different from the rest of the common rabble?

say:46:1010409029:0.text:
You bonehead! Do you know who you're talking to?!
The person standing in front of you is none other than the great and mighty Mer... Mmph, mmph, mmph!
say:46:1010409029:0.source_cn: 混蛋！知不知道你在和谁说话？！\n在你面前的可是那位大...
say:46:1010409029:0.male:
You bonehead! Do you know who you're talking to?!
The person standing in front of you is none other than the great and mighty Mer... Mmph, mmph, mmph!
say:46:1010409029:0.female:
You bonehead! Do you know who you're talking to?!
The person standing in front of you is none other than the great and mighty Mer... Mmph, mmph, mmph!

say:50:1010409032:0.text: How can I calm down when someone insults the magister like that?!
say:50:1010409032:0.source_cn: 我冷静不了！谁也不许说主人的坏话！！
say:50:1010409032:0.male: How can I calm down when someone insults the magister like that?!
say:50:1010409032:0.female: How can I calm down when someone insults the magister like that?!

say:53:1010409033:0.text: Summoning a couple of talking hairballs... All mages are mad, every last one of you.
say:53:1010409033:0.source_cn: 养着一群说话的耗子……果然魔法师都一样古怪。

say:56:1010409034:0.text: You seem to have some experience with mages, Lord Franz. Did you hear that a mage summoned fire elementals in Ryeham on the night of the fire?
say:56:1010409034:0.source_cn: 我听说金穗村发生火灾那晚，有魔法师召唤了火元素，这不就...

say:57:1010409035:0.text: Hmph! Insinuate all you want! It'll give you a chance to use that crusty brain of yours!
say:57:1010409035:0.source_cn: 尽管猜吧，尽管让你们生满铁锈的愚蠢脑袋运转吧！

say:58:1010409036:0.text: Don't overestimate yourselves. Making an enemy out of me is the worst thing you can do!
say:58:1010409036:0.source_cn: 不要以为自己掌握了胜机，和我作对，是你们步入失败的第一步！

narration:60:1010409037:0.text: Lord Franz arrogantly stomps away with his guards in tow.
narration:60:1010409037:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨带着护卫们嚣张地走远了

say:61:1010409038:0.text: That man's arrogance knows no bounds. He's been exposed, and yet he acts like nothing has happened...
say:61:1010409038:0.source_cn: 真是趾高气扬的人呐，明明已经被当面揭穿了……

say:62:1010409039:0.text:
What's this <style="highlight">Golden Banquet</style> that he mentioned just now?
He's throwing a feast just to celebrate the harvest?

say:64:1010409040:0.text: Didn't hear about that. Lord Franz's manor is like a fortress, and he's never been one to have guests.
say:64:1010409040:0.source_cn: 没听说过。弗朗茨的府邸守卫比堡垒都森严，过去他从不邀请客人。

say:65:1010409041:0.text: So why would he suddenly want to throw a banquet now?
say:65:1010409041:0.source_cn: 那这次为什么要隆重地宴请宾客呢……

say:67:1010409042:0.text: My thoughts exactly... Something doesn't add up.
say:67:1010409042:0.male: My thoughts exactly... Something doesn't add up.
say:67:1010409042:0.female: My thoughts exactly... Something doesn't add up.

say:68:1010409043:0.text: If we attend the banquet, we might find some new clues.
say:68:1010409043:0.source_cn: 要是我们也能参加宴会，说不定会有所收获呢。

say:69:1010409046:0.text: Did you see that gold invitation he gave to the lady? Where can we get ourselves one?
say:69:1010409046:0.source_cn: 你们刚才看见拿给夫人那张金灿灿的邀请函了吗？我们去哪能...

say:70:1010409047:0.text: I think I may know someone who can do that for us.
say:70:1010409047:0.source_cn: 我猜，说不定有一个人可以。

say:72:1010409048:0.text:
Yes, that young man could be our ticket in.
We should go see him at the Mithril Consortium.
say:72:1010409048:0.source_cn: 没错，那位高贵的小少爷也许有办法。\n我们动身去秘银商...

say:74:1010409044:0.text: I envy the rich sometimes... They'll throw a feast for even the smallest of reasons.
say:74:1010409044:0.source_cn: 真羡慕有钱人呀……随便找个理由，就能举办宴会。

say:75:1010409045:0.text: But I have a feeling that if we attend the banquet, we might find some new clues.
say:75:1010409045:0.source_cn: 不过，我有种预感，要是我们也能参加宴会，说不定会有所收获呢。

choice:54:0:1.source_cn: 还有其他魔法师？请引荐

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 可能是我的外貌太出众

choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 可能是猜到了我的真实身份
